name: Cerebro
description: electron-updater SHA512 for app; BUT plugin channel = plain-HTTP npm, no verify, auto-installs+executes every 12h — content-as-code RCE.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: Cerebro’s inspected primary updater uses electron-updater. Its plugin updater is a separate channel with different transport and artifact-verification controls. Report those channels separately; the source observations here do not certify the original host-execution impact claim.
limitations: This is a newly retrieved default-branch snapshot rather than the original study release; no network endpoint or exploitability testing was performed, and the evidence does not establish that every plugin update is automatically installed or that any specific content executes under a particular user action.

original_evidence.text: | Cerebro (app update) | github.com/KELiON/cerebro | Electron (Node/JS), electron-updater | Y | chk/dl auto (10s after launch, then hourly); inst auto on quit | Y | https (GitHub Releases via electron-updater generic "github" provider) | N (plain `latest*.yml` served over HTTPS, no separate signature on the manifest itself) | hash-from-manifest (SHA512 in `latest.yml`/`latest-mac.yml`, checked by electron-updater); macOS additionally subject to OS Gatekeeper/code-signing on the .dmg | N/A (hash embedded in HTTPS-fetched YAML; no independent signing key) | app/initAutoUpdater.js:1-26 (auto chk 10s+1h, no autoDownload override so electron-updater default `autoDownload:true` applies); app/main/main.js:43-45 ("will be automatically installed on quit"); app/main/createWindow/checkForUpdates.js:2,28-56 (manual "Check for Updates" menu path, opens external browser as fallback); electron-builder.json:93-97 (`"publish":{"provider":"github"}`) |

| Cerebro (plugin channel) | github.com/KELiON/cerebro | npm-style plugin loader, JS executed in-process | Y (separate from app updater) | chk auto every 12h at startup; dl+inst auto, no user confirmation | Y — downloaded code is extracted straight into `node_modules` and loaded/executed inside the Electron main process | **http** for the registry metadata call; **https** (`https.get`) for the tarball itself, but the tarball URL is taken unvalidated from the http-fetched JSON | N (no signature) | **none** — no hash or signature check anywhere in install/update path | N/A | app/lib/plugins/npm.js:14 (`const API_BASE = 'http://registry.npmjs.org/'`); npm.js:88 (`fetch(`${API_BASE}${name}`)` over plain HTTP); npm.js:37 (`https.get(tarPath, ...)` — URL for this https call is taken from the unauthenticated http response, so an on-path attacker can redirect it); npm.js:28-53 (extract tar directly to plugin dir, no checksum/signature check at any point); app/plugins/core/plugins/initializeAsync.js:26-43 (`checkForUpdates` runs at startup and every 12h and calls `client.update()` automatically for any plugin with `isUpdateAvailable`, no prompt) |
